segments.t: Con su camisa blanca impecable, Arthur se detiene junto a Hannah y Graham en mitad del pasillo y ya alarga la mano hacia el pincel pequeño para las esquinas. Escuchemos primero toda la escena.
What a lovely garden green! Give me a brush, the owner must help too!
Boss, you are wearing a snow white shirt and polished black shoes.
Just three neat slats on the bottom! I have a steady hand, watch!
Careful, Arthur, your sleeve is two centimeters from the wet edge...
Missed my shirt completely! Ha! Wait... my nose itches.
Arthur, do not lift the hand holding the green brush!
Why are you both staring at my forehead like that?
Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green.
My glasses were on my forehead again?! Oh, everything looks like a forest!
Stand completely still! Warm water and a soft cloth: off it comes!
Clean as new! Thank you, Hannah... I think I will go supervise the front desk.
Wise decision, boss. Leave the wet paint to us.
Analicemos paso a paso este pequeño percance lleno de color.
What a lovely garden green! Give me a brush, the owner must help too!
'¡Qué hermoso verde jardín! Denme un pincel, ¡el dueño también tiene que ayudar!'
Boss, you are wearing a snow white shirt and polished black shoes.
'Jefe, lleva puesta una camisa blanca como la nieve y zapatos negros lustrados.'
Just three neat slats on the bottom! I have a steady hand, watch!
'¡Solo tres tablillas limpias en la parte de abajo! Tengo buen pulso, ¡miren!'
Careful, Arthur, your sleeve is two centimeters from the wet edge...
'Cuidado, Arthur, su manga está a dos centímetros del borde húmedo...'
Missed my shirt completely! Ha! Wait... my nose itches.
'¡Esquivé mi camisa por completo! ¡Ja! Esperen... me pica la nariz.'
Arthur, do not lift the hand holding the green brush!
'¡Arthur, no levante la mano que sostiene el pincel verde!'
Why are you both staring at my forehead like that?
'¿Por qué me miran fijo la frente los dos de esa manera?'
Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green.
'Porque acaba de pintar de verde brillante el cristal izquierdo de sus gafas de lectura.'
My glasses were on my forehead again?! Oh, everything looks like a forest!
'¡¿Mis gafas estaban en mi frente otra vez?! ¡Oh, todo parece un bosque!'
Stand completely still! Warm water and a soft cloth: off it comes!
'¡Quédese completamente quieto! Agua tibia y un paño suave: ¡ya sale!'
Clean as new! Thank you, Hannah... I think I will go supervise the front desk.
'¡Limpio como nuevo! Gracias, Hannah... creo que iré a supervisar la recepción.'
Wise decision, boss. Leave the wet paint to us.
'Sabia decisión, jefe. Déjenos la pintura fresca a nosotros.'
Escuchemos de nuevo toda la escena.
What a lovely garden green! Give me a brush, the owner must help too!
Boss, you are wearing a snow white shirt and polished black shoes.
Just three neat slats on the bottom! I have a steady hand, watch!
Careful, Arthur, your sleeve is two centimeters from the wet edge...
Missed my shirt completely! Ha! Wait... my nose itches.
Arthur, do not lift the hand holding the green brush!
Why are you both staring at my forehead like that?
Because you just painted the left lens of your reading glasses bright green.
My glasses were on my forehead again?! Oh, everything looks like a forest!
Stand completely still! Warm water and a soft cloth: off it comes!
Clean as new! Thank you, Hannah... I think I will go supervise the front desk.
Wise decision, boss. Leave the wet paint to us.
Camisa blanca intacta y gafas salvadas a tiempo: ¡Arthur se retira prudentemente hacia el terreno seco de la recepción! Hasta enseguida.
See you soon!
